description: Earthquake impact and hazard products: Kyrgyzstan is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping. ADAM ID: sm\us6000rezr Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Oct 05 2025 26km NW of Bashky Terek. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 42.1574 longitude 71.2576. It impacted 25618 people within 50km. Coverage: Kyrgyzstan. The portal files it under the publisher WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping. Its tags are affected population, earthquake-tsunami, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-05-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
